name: QTT AI Action
description: One thing QTT OS asks an AI to do (write an article, reply to a customer…). Every AI call is recorded under its action code in QTT AI Usage Record — QTT Admin › AI. The list is kept by qtt_platform.ai_actions (new codes are added on deploy; your edits here are kept).

fields.label: Action code
fields.description: e.g. content.article.write — the code each AI call is recorded under.

fields.label: App area
fields.description: hr, erp, website, store, whatsapp, social, content, studio, team, os (qtt_platform.app_areas).

fields.label: Counts as an AI action on the plan
fields.description: Off for AI the business doesn't ask for itself (replies to its customers, daily reports) — unlimited on the plan.

fields.label: Model (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty to use the QTT Assistant model (QTT App Settings). A model ID here is used for this action only.
